selected_script.angle: A home cook fights wet countertop rot from dripping plates on towels, quickly snapping together a matte black 2-tier rack to route water away.
selected_script.hook: Stop putting wet dishes on soggy towels that ruin your kitchen countertops!

0-3s.description: Show a messy pile of dripping plates on a soggy, wet dish towel on a kitchen countertop, with pooling water starting to seep near the sink.

3-6s.description: The user places the matte black carbon steel base on the counter and snaps the side bracket of upper rack A into bottom base slot B by pushing down to snap-lock.

6-10s.description: The first clear result showing 11 plates organized in the top vertical slots, instantly clearing countertop space.

10-14s.description: Handheld shot of the user hanging the side utensil caddy and cutting board holder onto the outer wire frame.

14-18s.description: The user rotates and extends the bottom 360-degree drainage spout so it extends over the kitchen sink basin, letting water drain smoothly without pooling.

18-20s.description: A clean, dry countertop with the fully assembled rack. On-screen text: Upgrade your kitchen setup today.

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video, 9:16 ratio, realistic handheld phone-shot style. 0-3s: Show a real-life pain point with close-up details of a wet kitchen countertop covered in soggy towels and messy dripping dishes. 3-6s: Introduce the product solution by showing the user snap the upper tier of the matte black carbon steel rack into the bottom slots, instantly locking it in place. 6-10s: Show the first clean result with plates drying vertically in the top slots. Do not start with a perfect product shot. Do not end with a CTA. Maintain identical matte black carbon steel product appearance and texture.
